5. Caches Playwright browser binary
6. Installs Playwright chromium if cache miss
7. Installs deps if cache hit (continue-on-error)
8. Runs nx-set-shas
9. Generates icon sets and READMEs, checks git diff
10. Runs nx-cloud record -- nx format:check
11. Runs nx affected -t lint test build
12. Builds documentation
13. Checks published icon types (conditional)
14. Publishes preview packages (conditional)

- P-LIT-GHA-CACHE: Cache dependency downloads. The workflow already caches node_modules (via setup-node cache: pnpm) and Playwright browser. So dependency caching already exists - contraindication "An equivalent cache already exists".
- P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE: Cancel superseded runs. Not directly a workflow change in the same way, more of a CI service setting.
